deviations_from_card: ADR is 0117 (0108 was taken). No new `reconnect` action: the existing `connect` action carries {reuse_client:true}, so modules/connectors/index.ts (outside the write set) needs no change; the case-6 store half is tested as connect(id,{reuse_client:true}) sending exactly that body. stores/connectors.ts needed no change (pass-through). To honour the gate that no client id crosses the route, a flow started with the kept pair (_KeptClientFlow subclass in vault.py; oauth.py untouched) leaves authorize_url empty in its view, since the URL names the client id; the daemon opens the browser and the panel shows no 'Open the consent page again' link for that flow. The view also offers 'Use the kept client' to undo 'Use a different client'. Fixtures untouched; the interact test sets reconnect on the needs-reauth row.
notes: Case 5 (guard) is the route test: it passed before and after. The full pytest run was invoked with -p no:cacheprovider so no cache was written into the repo. No sibling reds seen. Not verified by hand in the Tauri window.
